description: Rewrite the summary and bullet points of one of the user's CVs to be stronger and more results-focused, optionally tailored to a target role. Returns suggestions — save the ones the user wants with save_takemeup_cv. PRO and AI consent. Use when the user asks to improve or rewrite their CV or resume.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

mode.description: roleTailor only applies with a targetRole.

name: rewrite_takemeup_cv
title: AI rewrite (PRO)
